Guidance on tag checks in detail
Watching the ramp lead is the best way to learn it
This page explains tag checks and why they matter for safe, calm pet travel at Aurelia Skyways. New staff should treat every tag as part of the animal's welfare record and every handoff as a chance to prevent delay, stress, or confusion. First, match the tag to the booking details, the carrier label, and the passenger statement, then confirm that the animal inside fits the approved plan. <<FACT F064>> This is especially important when a rabbit arrives with a crate that looks tidy but may still fail the welfare review. In the same way, inspect reptile cases with care and check that the enclosure shape supports secure travel. <<FACT F072>> If the passenger seems unsure, speak in plain language and guide them toward the welcome team, who can reinforce boarding steps with a calm tone. The welfare coordinator may also step in when comfort, ventilation, or spacing needs extra review. Good tag checks protect the pet, the passenger, and the service flow. Remember to verify, record, and report with steady attention every time.
